verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that admins can enforce attribute-based (ABAC) access policies controlling what data AI agents can see. That shows least-privilege thinking for agents, but it is not evidence of issuing scoped API credentials. Salesforce APIs exist, but nothing describes per-agent credential issuance or scoping. Missing for 10: documented scoped API tokens or OAuth scopes for agents, a credential issuance and revocation workflow, permission scoping tied to API credentials, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
